headline: Weathered Expanse Leads Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: WeatheredExpanseHex remains the war’s busiest base front, with forty-one ownership events in the past day, ten in six hours and four in the latest two; casualty activity remains heavy, while enlistments are accelerating. MooringCountyHex follows with thirty-one daily events and three in six hours, though its latest two-hour ledger is quiet; eleven Warden bases and one Colonial base currently stand. StlicanShelfHex records fourteen daily events, including two Warden captures, three Colonial captures and four neutralizations, with four Warden and five Colonial bases held. CallahansPassageHex has become a fresh point of interest, posting two events in the latest two hours at Crumbling Post and intense fighting on both sides, though the Wardens still hold nine of ten bases. PalantineBermHex shows eleven events in twenty-four hours but none in the latest six, and its casualty and enlistment surge has cooled. LinnMercyHex has three daily events at Rotdust, while its recent casualty rates have eased. NevishLineHex and FarranacCoastHex retain evidence of earlier movement, but neither reports fresh activity in the latest six hours. Most remaining regions are quiet or show only routine enlistment movement.
